subject: Vendor activation: DPA, SOC 2 evidence & PO instructions
messages:
From: Anjali Shah <anjali.shah@lakeside.tech>
To: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: procure@lakeside.tech
Date: 2029-04-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor activation: DPA, SOC 2 evidence & PO instructions

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for taking this — Lakeside is ready to move Redwood through our procurement gate. To finish vendor activation we need the following items from Redwood: 

- Executable DPA (we prefer DocuSign)
- SOC 2 attestation or a URL where we can download the report
- Current subprocessor roster (CSV or spreadsheet) with hosting/third-party categories
- Instructions for PO submission (billing contact, required PO language, invoice cadence)

Can you also confirm if Redwood supports data residency options and whether any subprocessors handle customer content? We aim to have the vendor fully activated by week end so our engineering team can provision API keys.

I've attached our vendor intake (filled) and our standard PO template for your reference.

(Attachment: Lakeside_Security_Questionnaire_v2.pdf)
(Attachment: Lakeside_PO_Template.docx)

Best,
Anjali Shah
Sr. Procurement Manager
Lakeside Technologies
anjali.shah@lakeside.tech
+1 415 555 0124

From: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Anjali Shah <anjali.shah@lakeside.tech>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2029-04-18T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor activation: DPA, SOC 2 evidence & PO instructions

Hi Anjali — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Laura (legal) and Rishi (security) to help with the artifacts. Quick plan and items attached: 

1) DPA: I’ve initiated a DocuSign envelope for the Redwood standard DPA (link below). Please sign and we’ll countersign same day.
   - DocuSign envelope: https://www.docusign.com/sign?txn=ABC123
2) SOC 2: public report link below (redacted PII). If you need the full auditor letter we can provide a download link to the secure share.
   - SOC 2 report: https://redwoodinference.app/link/soc2-report-2028
3) Subprocessors: current CSV export added to our shared drive; includes categories (hosting, analytics, payments). Link included below.
   - Subprocessors: https://drive.redwood.com/subprocessors/list_v3.csv
4) PO/invoice: Redwood requires the vendor PO to reference our customer ID field (CustomerID: LKD-10294). Invoice should be sent to billing@redwood.ai with PO number in subject. Net30 by default unless special terms agreed. I’ve attached a short text file with invoice routing examples.

Next steps: once the DPA is signed and we have the PO number, provisioning will begin and we’ll issue API keys and onboarding instructions. 

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_for_Signature.pdf (sent via DocuSign), PO_10294_invoice_instructions.txt

Let me know if you need any contract redlines — Laura, can you confirm no special clauses required for data residency at this stage?

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Commercial Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
(Attachment: Redwood_DPA_for_Signature.pdf)
(Attachment: PO_10294_invoice_instructions.txt)

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2029-04-19T08:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor activation: DPA, SOC 2 evidence & PO instructions

Stephanie / Rishi — quick internal note before we reply to Lakeside: 

- I reviewed the intake; the DPA is the standard Redwood template. We should add the data-residency addendum only if Lakeside requires a specific region (they asked). Ask them to confirm region (US/EU) so we can attach the addendum if needed.
- Rishi: please scan the subprocessor CSV for any new entries from 2029 Q1 (esp. monitoring/analytics vendors). Flag anything with access to customer content.
- Priyom: once DPA signed, can you prepare the onboarding checklist we send to partners (account activation, API key rotation schedule, support SLAs)?

I will do a quick contract pass for any redlines (30 mins). If nothing material, we’ll countersign.

Laura Bennett
Head of Legal Ops, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
(Internal note)

From: Marco Bellini <procure@lakeside.tech>
To: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Anjali Shah <anjali.shah@lakeside.tech>
Date: 2029-04-21T10:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor activation: DPA, SOC 2 evidence & PO instructions

Hi Stephanie / Laura — thanks. We signed the DPA this morning via DocuSign and attached the signed copy for your records.

(Attachment: Signed_DPA_Lakeside.pdf)

A couple quick follow-ups from our security team: 
- Is the SOC 2 report you provided a public summary or the full auditor report? They asked for the auditor letter and control coverage detail.
- For subprocessors, could you add a brief column indicating whether the subprocessor has access to customer content (yes/no) — will speed our review.

Also — we will issue a PO from Lakeside later today. Who should the PO be addressed to (billing address and contact)? We will use the PO number in the subject line when emailing the invoice.

Thanks,
Marco Bellini
Procurement Lead
Lakeside Technologies
procure@lakeside.tech
(Attachment: Lakeside_PO_Intent.docx)

From: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>

Date: 2029-04-22T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor activation: DPA, SOC 2 evidence & PO instructions

Hi Marco / Anjali — great, thanks for signing. 

1) SOC 2: the link we provided is the full SOC 2 Type II report summary with auditor letter available via secure download. If you reply with the email for the security reviewer we’ll provision a temporary download link to the full packet.

2) Subprocessors: we updated the CSV to include an \"access_to_customer_content\" column (yes/no) and re-uploaded to the shared link. 
   - Updated list: https://drive.redwood.com/subprocessors/list_v3.csv

3) PO and billing: please address the PO to:
   Redwood Inference, Inc.
   Attn: Billing Operations
   billing@redwood.ai
   Include CustomerID: LKD-10294 in the PO body.

Once we receive the PO (please email the PDF to billing@redwood.ai with PO number in the subject) we will: 
- confirm the billing contact
- provision API keys and an onboarding packet
- issue the first invoice per the instructions we attached earlier

We also attached the countersigned DPA for your records.

(Attachment: Redwood_DPA_Lakeside_Signature_20290421.pdf)
(Attachment: PO_10294_invoice_instructions.txt)

If you want the secure SOC 2 download link now, tell me the reviewer email and I’ll share it.

Cheers,
Stephanie Nguyen
